title: HDMI CEC controller: bit timing, arbitration and ACK, messages in memory over AXI4
features: Open-drain line: cec_in samples it, cec_oe_low pulls it low. Tick = TICK_DIV + 1 clocks, nominally 0.05 ms: start bit 3.7 ms low / 4.5 ms, bit 0 1.5 ms low, bit 1 0.6 ms low, 2.4 ms period, sample at 1.05 ms.

Receive: messages to logical address LA (or all with PROMISC) and broadcasts; directed blocks are ACKed. Each message takes one 32-byte RX slot: word 0 {flags (bcast, acked), len}, words 1..4 the bytes.

Transmit: CMD.tx_start fetches 5 words at TX_ADDR (word 0 = length, words 1..4 bytes), waits SFT bit periods of free line, sends with arbitration (lost in the first 4 bits: TX_STATUS.arb_lost) and checks ACK (TX_STATUS.nack).
RX ring of RX_SLOTS slots at RX_BASE (RX_WR / RX_RD).

fields.desc: send the message at TX_ADDR; ignored while tx_busy
{err, arb_lost, nack, ok} of the last message
messages lost to a full ring

irqs.name: ERR
irqs.desc: a job ended that saw an AXI error response

sequence: Write TIMING (TICK_DIV = clock x 50 us - 1, SFT), RX_BASE, RX_RING, CTRL with enable and LA.
Receive: on RX read slots RX_RD .. RX_WR - 1 and write RX_RD.
Transmit: write the message to memory, TX_ADDR, CMD.tx_start; on TX_DONE read TX.
notes: m_* is the AXI4 manager port (32-bit address and data, 4-bit ID, no user / QoS); it passes through unchanged. Bursts are INCR, AxSIZE = 2 (4 bytes), 1 to 16 beats, WSTRB = 4'hF, never across a 4 KB boundary; one read and one write burst are outstanding at a time.
cec_in / cec_oe_low are the line pins (open drain: the pad pulls low when cec_oe_low is 1).
The core testbench prints one `LAT <master> dram R|W <cycles>` line per AXI burst (tb/tv_lat_mon.svh), the regression suite's latency format.
